maes-1.why: Simultaneous equations involve multiple variables and require logical reasoning, which I find moderately challenging but manageable.

maes-2.why: Decimals are straightforward for me; basic operations like addition and subtraction come easily.

maes-3.why: Determining missing angles requires knowledge of geometric principles, which I understand well enough to apply in most cases.

maes-4.why: Algebra problems are my strength; I enjoy solving equations and finding unknown values.

maes-5.why: Trigonometry concepts like sine, cosine, and tangent are moderately complex but not too difficult for me.

maes-6.why: Calculating area and volume is practical and I can visualize the shapes involved easily.

maes-7.why: Sketching curves involves understanding function behavior, which I find moderately challenging but achievable.

maes-8.why: Working with fractions is second nature to me; basic operations like addition and division are quick and accurate.

maes-9.why: Determining missing side lengths requires knowledge of geometric properties, which I apply confidently.
